newsitem.title: UK: London FTSE 100 ends year at record.
newsitem.headline: London FTSE 100 ends year at record.

text.p: The London Stock Exchange's FTSE 100 index closed at a record 4,118.5 Tuesday, posting a gain of 11.6 percent for the year.

The increase compared with the FTSE 100's 20.3 percent gain in 1995 and its 10.0 percent decline in 1994 but was well below the 35 percent rise in 1989 -- the index's best annual performance since it was created in January 1984.
